issues.description: Method name mismatch for the Farm song operation: the problem statement and the template declare/expect a public method named singFarmSong() on class de.tum.cit.ase.Farm, but the reference solution implements a public method named playFarmSong() instead. Template and solution Main.java files also contain a (commented) call to farm.singFarmSong(), which does not match the solution's playFarmSong() method. This naming inconsistency between the specified API (singFarmSong) and the solution (playFarmSong) can confuse students about which public method they must implement and which call site is correct.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the public API name consistent across artifacts. Preferably rename the solution's public method playFarmSong() to singFarmSong() (and update its internal references) so it matches the problem statement and the template Main usage. Alternatively, update the problem statement and template Main to reference playFarmSong(), but ensure all three artifacts (problem text, template, and solution) use the same method name.
